verdict.rationale: Atlassian advertises 'Rich APIs', and community users confirm the REST API works for core tasks such as running JQL queries and scripting bug-report creation. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches everything the UI can do. The OpenAPI probes found no spec at the guessed paths, so coverage can't be checked. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, evidence the API covers configuration, workflows, boards and admin, and independent hands-on confirmation of broad coverage.
